div.p: You can copy the icon as SVG to paste in almost any editor (Figma, Sketch, Illustrator, etc.), or copy as component to use in your web apps.
Iconify provides a runtime solution that fetches icons on the go. Refer its documentation for more details.
Created by the author of Icônes. With the power of UnoCSS, you can use the icons with Pure CSS using @unocss/preset-icons.
Check out this blog post for more.
Created by the author of Icônes, unplugin-icons is a on-demand solution to generate icons as components on the fly.
Check out this blog post for the story behind.
